data.explanation: This letter confirms your new electricity contract. Supply starts on 1 January 2026 and the initial term is 12 months. You pay a monthly advance payment (Abschlag) of €78.00. To end the contract at the end of the initial term, you must give one month's notice; the app calculates the cancellation deadline. If you don't cancel, the contract continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. The provider handles the switch from your old supplier, so you don't need to cancel that one yourself.
